explicit-setter-before-setproperty-ref-g:
Mode: MAXIMIZE STUDENT CAPABILITY

In ViewModels, since `Properties` and `INotifyPropertyChanged` are still at `Practicing` and `ref` is not yet recorded as mastered in `Learning/Student-Mastery.md`, we prefer the explicit 3-line property setter (`if (_username == value) return; _username = value; OnPropertyChanged();`). `SetProperty(ref _username, value)` passes the backing field by reference (`ref`) to update it and raise `OnPropertyChanged()`, which does not fail the build (it only emits a `[PEDAGOGICAL WARNING]`, and Custom Views/Controls are exempt). Would you prefer to use the explicit 3-line setter (recommended for Bagrut clarity), or keep `SetProperty(ref _username, value)` and learn/record the `ref` concept now in `Learning/Student-Mastery.md`?
